subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Appreciation Day
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce that our Annual Employee Appreciation Day is just around the corner! We have planned a fun-filled day with games, activities, and a delicious catered lunch to show our gratitude for all your hard work. Please mark your calendars for Friday, August 20th, and stay tuned for more details. We can't wait to celebrate with you all! Best regards, [Company Name]
